awareness: High - They are aware that the current process is very complex and needs to change
desire: High - They would highly benefit from a better system that would lighten their workload by removing straightforward cases off their plate
knowledge: Low - They would have no knowledge of the new system and would need to be taught how it works
ability: Low - the new system will be less complicated but still completely different to their previous process that they have become accustomed to
reinforcement: Medium - the new system allows them to more easily handle cases by having all account information readily available so they need not rely on the old multi-sheet system but under pressure/ if overwhelmed they might return to old methods. They may fear that the portal will put their jobs at risk
key_risk: 1. Teething problems could cause delays in handling of cases 2. The triaging system may not work effectively, causing reps to revert back to old system 3.  Fear of job displacement
mitigation_action: Ensure that reps are given enough time and supprt to be able to learn the new system before putting  hihg productivity expectations on them

awareness: High - They are aware that the current method of storing data is not law compliant and needs to change
desire: High - the new system would provide a centralised database which stores accurate account and finance data removes risk of breaching data compliance and failing audits
knowledge: Low - They have no knowledge of the new system and how it is structured yet
ability: Low - training is required to show them how they can access necessary data and metrics
reinforcement: High - The current process is not law compliant and puts them at risk of breaching data and contact laws. The new system provides a centralised database that increases tracability
key_risk: 1. Edge cases involving financial hardships and other personal customer diffiluties with payment could be misclassified as straightforward 2. Populating the central database with legacy databases info containing corrupted historical records risks propagating bad financial data across reporting dashboards
mitigation_action: 1. Have explicit eligibility decision tables with clear pathways/escalation for hardship and vulnerability flags. 2. Ensure that the database contains correct information by confirming with the account owners

awareness: Medium/low - Some may not be aware of their outstanding balance. They may have frustrations if they have been  contacted several times unnecessarily
desire: Low - they may benefit from having automated payments set ups but may prefer to speak with a person about their balance especially if their status hasn't taken into account certain limitations or diffulcties they may face with repayment.
knowledge: Low - they won't have any knowledge of the new system since it willl be completely different from the current one
ability: Medium - the portal should be easy for customers to use and access but it will take some time for them to become familiar with it
reinforcement: Low - They may not see the need for this as the current system means that each customer is handled by a representative who can explain their account status and payment options to them more clearly
key_risk: 1. It could take some time for them to be made aware of the change if they are not expecting communication via email 2. They may prefer to speak directly to a representative 3. They may stuggle to understand how the portal works 4. They may disagree with their account status or outstanding amount
mitigation_action: 1. Send out communications to delinquent accounts via email detailing the new system and resend to customers who have not opened the email. If they fail to opoen the emails for two weeks then send a letter home 2. Give them an option to flag if they are having hardships that complicate their case so that they may speak with a representative 3. Customers should be provided a portal walkthrough/induction video that clearly shows how it can be interacted with 4. Have the option to dispute their case in the portal
